1.o: Cha Ki Young, a successful anchorwoman in the late of her child-bearing years, meets chef and reporter, Park Tae Yun.

2.o: Ki Young is pregnant. Jo Eun Cha attempts to figure out a way to get Park Sun Nyeo off his back.

3.o: Ki Young tries to think of a way to have her baby and keep her career. Jo Eun Cha finds out about her pregnancy.

4.o: Ki Young and Eun Cha's trip to the hospital gets caught on camera. The secret of pregnancy slowly spreads.

5.o: Ki Young deals with the aftermath of the press conference, and her mother, who wants her to abort the baby.

6.o: Jo Eun Cha blackmails Ki Young into quitting her job. Park Tae Yun and Hyun Myung Yi start to date.

7.o: The news rating starts to fall under Eun Cha's anchorship. Park Tae Yun deals with Hyun Myung Yi's unexpected pregnancy.

8.o: Hyun Myung Yi moves in with Park Tae Yun. Cha Ki Young seeks an unlikely ally to protect her unborn child.

9.o: Hyun Myung Yi seeks the approval of Park Tae Yun's family, but finds it difficult to gain. Cha Ki Young deals with unsupportive coworkers at the news station.

10.o: Cha Ki Young faces the scorn of being an unwed mother, while Hyun Myung Yi struggles to keep Park Tae Yun's interest.

11.o: Cha Ki Young struggles with the difficulties of being a single working mother and hopes to save her job at the news station by hosting a fashion show.

12.o: Park Tae Yun's family discovers that their son is the father of Cha Ki Young's child and set out to claim young Dan as their own.

13.o: Cha Ki Young is distraught at Dan's disappearance and sets out to revover her son, no matter the cost.

14.o: Channel Korea breaks the news that Cha Ki Young did not recieve a sperm donation, leading to a country-wide backlash against the former anchor.

15.o: Cha Ki Young and Park Tae Yun go head-to-head in a custody battle over their son.

16.o: Cha Ki Young and Park Tae Yun clash over the custody of their child one last time as Jo Eun Cha's election day finally arrives.

1.o: Sora and Shiro are unemployed and never leave their house, but on the net, they're known as "Blank", an invincible team of gamers. One day, these siblings are visited by a boy named Tet, who calls himself god. Tet summons them to a world where all war is banned, and everything is decided by games.

2.o: Sora and Shiro have been abandoned in another world by Tet. In this world all war is forbidden, and everything is determined by games whose rules are determined by the "Ten Pledges" that Tet established. They find themselves in the country of humanity, the weakest of the 16 races in this new world.

3.o: A girl named Clamy has won the right to be the next king of Elukia by her overwhelming good luck. Steph lost to her and loses the chance to become the next ruler. Just as she defeats the last challenger, however, Sora and Shiro interrupt her.

4.o: The game Clamy challenged them to wasn't normal chess. Shiro is a chess master, but even she is helpless against Clami's assault. But when Shiro understands the real rules of the game, things begind to turn around. The battle to determine the king of Elukia, and all of humanity, finally reaches its end.

5.o: Sora and Shiro leave the running of the country to Steph and spend every day playing video games. Steph's hope that they would become not only the saviors of Elukia, but all of humanity, crumbles away.

6.o: The siblings confront Jibril, a member of the Flügel race to reclaim the royal library in a game of Shiritori.

7.o: Intending to challenge the Werebeasts, the siblings discover that it's hard to come with a strategy to defeat the latter, as all memories regarding the games are erased from their challengers, until Stephanie entrusts Sora a key left by the former king, leading to his secret research on how to outwit them.

8.o: Sora, Shiro, Steph and Jibril devise a risky plan with even riskier stakes, making their way to the Warbeast embassy to challenge them.

9.o: Foul play is suspected when Sora is nowhere to be found after Shiro wakes up, spurring him to action.

10.o: Sora, Shiro and the rest prepare themselves for a game with the Warbeasts through trust exercises and cunning strategy. The stakes are high, but Sora, as always, has a plan.

11.o: Izuna, though powerful, has been matched in gameplay. This first person shooter will test their limits in virtual space. As tensions flare, friendly fire becomes imminent.

12.o: While Izuna's abilities seemingly defy physics, Sora and Shiro make potentially futile attempts to amp up their game.

1.o: Uno Saki is a 15 year old girl trying to make it (unsuccessfully) as an idol singer. One day, on her way home from a concert, she notices a violent-looking man trying to break into her home...

2.o: Saki has become a magical girl to save her beloved Mohiro! Fortunately, Mohiro doesn't recognize her behind her disguise. Unfortunately, he's not the only one who was watching her fight...

3.o: Sakuyo has transformed using love power to save Saki from a scary situation. As Saki struggles with how to react, Sakuyo tells a tale of their youth, and reveals to her friend her true feelings!

4.o: Saki and Sakuya are getting their first TV booking as Magical Girl idols! But when a nervous Saki runs into Mohiro at the studio, she notices a strange man clinging to him...

5.o: Exhausted by their lives as magical girl idols, Saki and Sakuyo take a well-deserved vacation in Okinawa. Could this be the long-awaited swimsuit episode?!

6.o: Saki and Sakuyo visit a hot springs town for their first performance in a while as Magical Twins. But as it happens, Mohiro and Hyoe are also there shooting a PV...

7.o: At last, the magical girls are getting the major CD debut they've been dreaming of! But their manager Konami insists they go to karaoke for training...

8.o: Saki and Sakuyo are making waves as idols with their first hit CD. At a joint meet-and-greet with Star Prince and PRISMA, they interact with waves of fans. But one unwelcome visitor has infiltrated their ranks...

9.o: While Saki and Sakuyo are on the rise, the idol unit PRISMA is suffering from a shrinking fanbase. Then one day, a man calling himself a magical girl scout comes and makes them an offer they can't refuse!

10.o: Saki and Sakuyo finally realize that Hyoe is the common figure involved in all the demon incidents! In order to track his activities, they opt to disguise themselves and follow him and Mohiro around town.

1.o: بعد أن اكتفت من والديها المحرِجَين، تتّجه "جيسي" إلى الشاطئ للترويح عن نفسها، وتقابل دمية تقدّم لها عرضًا مُغريًا.

2.o: بعد ادّعاء الإصابة بالحمّى لعدم الذهاب إلى المدرسة، يتجسّس "ستو" على مُحبة القطط في الجهة المقابلة من الشارع، ويقتنع أنها تدبر أمرًا شريرًا.

3.o: يعجز "سام"، طالب المدرسة الداخلية، عن مقاومة نشر الأكاذيب عن أصدقائه على الإنترنت. وبعد منشوراته الدنيئة الكثيرة، تُطارده طرقه في التصيّد.

4.o: تتحمّس "كيم" حين يجعلها هاتفها الجديد مشهورةً في المدرسة، حتّى تدرك أنّ "مارتي"، الذكاء الاصطناعي في الهاتف، مهتمّ أكثر من اللازم بحياتها.

5.o: أثناء استكشاف بيت عمّته، يعثر "فنسنت" على بوابة تعود به إلى الماضي ويقابل والده وهو صبيّ... فهل تستطيع صداقتهما تغيير المستقبل؟

6.o: حين تجهّز "بيرل" غير الاجتماعية لحفل عيد ميلادها الخامس عشر، تستدرجها همسات غامضة نحو الماء، حيث تكتشف موهبةً خفيةً.

7.o: في رحلة تخييم لـ"جوّالات القنفذ"، تسارع المُستجدّة "دنت" والقائدة "جايني" للهرب من وباء يحيل الفتيات الأخريات إلى كائنات زومبي مُدندنة.

8.o: بعد الانتقال إلى الريف، يتّجه "توماس" إلى الغابة مع جاره ويعثران على موقع هبوط اضطراري غريب، ومخلوق عالق بعيدًا عن وطنه.

9.o: تحبّ جليسة الأطفال "إيسميه" خداع الأطفال بالنوم مبكرًا عن طريق سردها لقصص مخيفة لهم... لكنّها ذات ليلة سوداء عاصفة، تُقابل ندّها.

10.o: حين يرى "غريغ" صديقه العزيز السابق يتصرّف بغرابة، يتبعه إلى سقيفة مُخيفة، حيث تكمن قوّة خارقة للطبيعة في الظلال.

11.o: يمنح صندوق يُجمّد الزمن المشاغبَين "جودي" و"براندون" طرقًا جديدة لعمل المقالب في جيرانهما، لكنّهما سرعان ما يدركان أنّ مرحهما ثمنه باهظ.

12.o: حين ينضمّ وافد جديد إلى فرقة السيرك، يُصارع "آيس" نجم العرض أسئلةً عن العالم الخارجيّ والعائلة التي تركها وراءه.

13.o: باستخدام الصور من حلمه كدليل، ينطلق "آيس" للعثور على عائلته، لكنّه يواجه عقبةً محبطةً، وتخاطر "إنديغو" بكلّ شيء لمساعدته.

1.o: لا يستطيع "جاك" المقاومة، فهو يسهر لوقت متأخّر لممارسة لعبة الفيديو التي يحبّها، ولكنّه في أحد الأيام يُدرك أنّها قد كلّفته ثمنًا غاليًا.

2.o: سبق أن اجتاح وباء القمل المدرسة التي يدرس فيها "غيب"، ولكن تلك الكائنات الدقيقة تخطّط هذه المرّة لغزو هائل، ولا يشعر بقدومها أحد إلا "غيب".

3.o: تصدر "مولي" وشقيقها أوامر لآلة المساعدة الافتراضية "آفا" بفظاظة دومًا. وحين يذهب والداهما في رحلة، تقرّر "آفا" تلقين الطفلين درسًا لا يُنسى.

4.o: يتوه ثلاثة أشقّاء منهكين من السفر في متاهة معقّدة غامضة بعد أن تضغط أصغرهم على كلّ الأزرار في مصعد الفندق... فهل ينجون بعد كلّ ما سيواجهونه؟

5.o: يُعاقَب خمسة طلاب في المدرسة الثانوية بالاحتجاز يوم العطلة الأسبوعية، لكن الشكوك تساورهم حول السيّدة المُكلّفة بمراقبتهم، فهي تُخفي حقيقتها.

6.o: بعد تنزيل "كيرا" المهووسة بصور السيلفي تطبيقًا يمحو كلّ عيوب ملامحها، يدفعها تأثيره الجانبي الصادم لطلب مساعدة أختها البارعة في التكنولوجيا.

7.o: حين يصل شقيق "ميا" الرضيع إلى البيت قادمًا من المستشفى بعد ولادته، تبدأ أشياء غريبة في الحدوث داخل المنزل... وتتلقّى "ميا" كلّ اللوم.

8.o: فور حصول "أليكسا" على فرصة للمنافسة ضدّ الفتيان لتظفر بمكان في مسابقة المصارعة الإقليمية، تصلها رسالة نصّية غامضة تعرض عليها هديةً خاصّة.

9.o: ينتهي حفل عيد الميلاد الساهر لمُدوّنة الفيديوهات "كاس" بكارثة، فما السبب؟ ستعود بكم الحلقة بلقطات مصوّرة إلى بداية الحفل للعثور على أدلّة.

10.o: يتسبّب حظّ عاثر في العطلة بحبس الصديقين "لورنس" و"مايكي" داخل متجر كبير للهدايا بعد موعد إغلاقه، ويطاردهما داخله "بابا نويل" الآليّ المخيف.

1.o: Pinned down by heavy enemy fire in a field near Cisterna, Italy, in 1944, U.S. Army Sgt. Sylvester Antolak leads a charge that becomes legendary.

2.o: Outgunned and outmanned during an attack on a remote Afghanistan outpost in 2009, U.S. Army Staff Sgt. Clint Romesha leads an improbable defense.

3.o: Relegated to the rank of private due to institutional racism in WWII, experienced soldier Edward Carter single-handedly cripples an enemy stronghold.

4.o: Resorting to hand-to-hand combat, Hershey Miyamura covers the retreat of his men as waves of Chinese soldiers overrun his position in the Korean War.

5.o: Declared 4-F due to poor eyesight, Vito Bertoldo later joins the U.S. Army anyway and ends up halting an enemy advance alone at the front lines.

6.o: During a vicious nighttime battle in Korea, U.S. Marine Joe Vittori rotates between machine gun nests, making the enemy think it faces a larger force.

7.o: His radar station besieged by Vietnamese troops, Air Force Chief Master Sgt. Richard Etchberger is exposed to enemy fire while his comrades evacuate.

8.o: U.S. Army Specialist Ty Carter's bravery while wounded and under fire earns him the second Medal of Honor awarded for a Taliban attack in 2009.

1.o: Detective John Kelly has his hands full. On the work front, his partner's drinking problem and continual harassment of gangster Alfonse Giardella is about to get them both in over their heads with the mob. On the personal front, his wife wants a divorce.

2.o: Lieutenant Fancy and Detective Kelly are warned to stop pressuring the mob even as Andy Sipowicz lies in the hospital with numerous gunshot wounds. Back at Kelly's ex-wife's apartment building, an angry young man starts carrying a gun for protection.

3.o: After discovering the hotel where Giardella is being held, Sipowicz gets his revenge with the help of a pet bulldog and the hotel's thankful chef.

4.o: Kelly quits moonlighting as a bodyguard after discovering his millionaire employer is a wife beater. Later Kelly speaks at a tenant meeting explaining the dangers of carrying a gun for protection. Unfortunately, his talk has little impact on the tenant in 4B.

5.o: Martinez discovers the superintendent of his brother's apartment building is a cop who beats and robs tenants who fall behind on their rent.

6.o: Kelly is forced to arrest a close friend after a fight on the basketball court leaves another friend dead.

7.o: When Sipowicz's estranged son, Andy Jr., shows up and announces his engagement, Andy Sr. decides to look into the bride-to-be's background.

8.o: Lieutenant Fancy hires Donna Abandando, a well-endowed civilian employee, to work in the precinct's "safe street" program.

9.o: When Martinez's brother dies from a drug overdose, their father sets out to kill the drug dealer responsible.

10.o: Ignoring Kelly's advice, Licalsi reveals that she's being blackmailed by the mob. Kelly and Sipowicz investigate the brutal robbery-murder of a wealthy family and work with a pawn dealer in hopes of retrieving a stolen Oscar statuette.

11.o: As the holiday's approach, Kelly and Sipowicz get a early gift in the form of a hot tip while investigating the kidnapping of a young girl.

12.o: While Martinez investigates a series of robberies involving a fake ATM machine, Kelly's current case yields evidence that links Licalsi to the mob. Meanwhile, Lt. Fancy tries to extend his custody of a young boy whose mother is in a drug rehabilitation program.

13.o: Donna's joy over Medavoy leaving his wife is short-lived when he has a change of heart.

14.o: When a woman who was raped refuses to press charges for fear her husband will say she brought it upon herself, Licalsi acts as a decoy in an attempt to trap the prime suspect.

15.o: When Kelly and Sipowicz respond to a suicide call they find the body of a police informant who had come to the precinct earlier that day shouting that she was sleeping with her police contact. Licalsi suspects that her partner is taking drugs.

16.o: Sipowicz has to diffuse an explosive situation when a disabled Vietnam vet who was mugged decides to take matters into his own hands.

17.o: Sipowicz is furious when he suspects a private investigator is giving false hope to a man whose daughter has been missing for 2 and a half years.

18.o: When a material witness to a drug hit turns up dead, Sipowicz and Kelly's investigation leads them to two brothers who have also planned a hit on Kelly's ex-wife, Laura. Sipowicz must perform uniform-detail in a dress uniform way too small.

19.o: Detectives searching a landfill for the body of a dead girl find the body of a millionaire instead. While Kelly interviews the wife of the deceased, Sipowicz does some investigating of his own after Andy Jr. is arrested for selling cocaine.

20.o: Kelly and Sipowicz investigate the death of a man's mistress, which they later find out is one of many lovers the man currently has. Meanwhile, Licalsi is promoted and Fancy breaks the news to her husband that she's pregnant.

21.o: Even as Licalsi confesses to shooting Angelo Marino and his driver, Martinez is forced to shoot an irate man who points a gun at Medavoy while they're stuck in traffic.

22.o: Sipowicz and Kelly investigate the stabbing death of a priest whose body was found in a park frequented by male prostitutes.

1.o: Licalsi tries to plea bargain his case and only get six years in prison for the murder, but Kelly is greatly opposed to the bargain after realizing he's in love with Janice. After learning that Kelly still has feelings for Janice, Robin ends their relationship. Meanwhile, Sipowicz and Kelly go on a stakeout of an apartment complex that have been the target of several robberies.

2.o: Licalsi takes the stand during her trial. The Internal Affairs Bureau investigates Kelly and Sipowicz in regards to the arrest of Officer Guyce and Officer Quint. Meanwhile, Kelly, Sipowicz, Medavoy and Martinez investigate the murder of a black couple.

3.o: Kelly investigates the death of an undercover cop in Chinatown, and to do so he must accept help from a prominent Chinese gang leader. Meanwhile, Sipowicz finds out that a former abuse case he had worked on has escalated into homicide; and Medavoy and Donna's relationship is revealed after Lt. Fancy catches them in the act, leading to Fancy warning the precinct against interoffice relationships.

4.o: Kelly's future with the force is decided as he investigates the death of an 18-month old baby shot in a drive-by while riding in a car driven by Duane Rollins. Though everyone believes the act was random, Kelly believes that Rollins was the intended target. Meanwhile, Sipowicz finds the body of a cop, and must continue dealing with both his commitments to Alcoholics Anonymous and his feelings for Sylvia Costas.

5.o: In Kelly's absence, Detective Bobby Simone joins the force and is assigned to work with Sipowicz on a case involving the murder of a mob member's son. Later at the precinct, her boyfriend, Detective Jimmy Abruzzo, threatens Detective Lesniak with a gun; and a woman claims her husband is sexually abusing her 14-year old daughter.

6.o: A chiropractor's wife is found murdered and Simone and Sipowicz discover that the chiropractor, Dr. Peter Shennon, was having an affair with his secretary, Judith Krasky, which turns all suspicions towards him. Meanwhile, while working for a security company, Martinez falls for Leticia Beltran, a college student he's assigned to protect. Later, a woman, Christine Williamson, brings Simone a gun she found her 11-year old son playing with.

7.o: An 11-year old boy admits to killing an Hispanic student in the midst of a turf-war at his elementary school, but Simone has a suspicion that the boy is taking the fall for someone. When a ladies' man, Eddie Reyna, learns he's HIV positive, he becomes targeted by one of his former lovers that he infected with the disease. Meanwhile, Donna's sister, Dana, comes to town for a visit, which causes a rift between Donna and Medavoy.

8.o: Sipowicz and Simone are assigned to the case of a pregnant woman who was murdered and the only charred remnants remain, which means there are few clues for the detectives to go by. Meanwhile, Sipowicz grows increasingly concerned when a close friend, Dan Breen, is badly beaten by his mentally handicapped son, Danny.

9.t: Don We Now Our Gay Apparel
9.o: Simone and Sipowicz investigate the murder of a gay bar proprietor and have transsexual Candace La Rue as a material witness. Dan Breen decides to visit his mentally disturbed son, Danny, despite Sipowicz warning him not to do so. Elsewhere, Medavoy investigates a fortune telling scam after a woman is conned out of her life savings; and Lt. Fancy's wife goes into labor.

10.o: Detective Soloman tries to use his status to steal a case from Detective Simone after Simone arrested a notorious serial killer, Putnam. Meanwhile, Commander Haverill tricks Lt. Fancy into lying about a case involving a crime lord; Lesniak goes after a flasher; Sipowicz once again proposes to Sylvia Costas; and Benita Alden, a reporter, flirts with Simone.

11.o: Simone and Sipowicz follow hot on the trail of the "Webster Dictionary" serial killer, though bureau politics take their toll on the case. Meanwhile, Sipowicz uses Vinnie Greco as an informant in order to try to stop a bank heist; and Lt. Fancy enlists Greco's help in order to get even with Commander Haverill.

12.o: The detectives investigate the brutal murder of a young woman. Their investigation leads to one main suspect – Derrick Cobb, the girl's former stepfather. Simone worries that one of his close friends, Raymond diSalvo, has gotten involved in drug dealing at a dance club. Lesniak investigates con artist Mac McClellan.

13.o: Three fast-food employees are murdered execution-style. As Simone and Sipowicz investigate the murders, Martinez and Lesniak look into the attempted rape of an elderly woman. Meanwhile, Sipowicz and Sylvia Costas have differences when it comes to planning their wedding; and Martinez becomes jealous when Lesniak has lunch with an old friend, Dr. Druzinski.

14.t: A Murder with Teeth in It
14.o: Simone and Sipowicz investigate the death of a pimp, but all evidence they find points to one of their own, Jerry McCabe. Medavoy's constant jealously causes Donna to rethink their relationship and Simone begins to worry that Benita Alden is using him for her career gains.

15.o: Simone and Sipowicz are assigned to investigate Vartan Illiescu, an immigrant suspected of being a terrorist. An unknown person kills George Putnam, a serial killer, out of revenge before he can be tried in court. Meanwhile, Medavoy and Donna's relationship crumbles after Medavoy gets advice from Dana.

16.o: Simone and Sipowicz are put on the case of a teenager known for his graffiti work who was brutally murdered. Meanwhile, Donna continues to contemplate her relationship Medavoy; and Sylvia is mugged, which results in a deep secret being revealed to Sipowicz.

17.o: Simone has to convince Joyce Novak, a witness in a double-homicide case, to testify. Sipowicz is assigned to investigate the murder of an elderly woman who was the owner of a candy store he worked at when he was growing up.

18.o: A man goes on a shooting spree, killing a waitress, two cops and three other citizens before he was apprehended. Meanwhile, Lt. Fancy speaks on behalf of Reggie after Reggie squares off with Sgt. MacNamara.

19.o: Simone becomes attracted to an undercover cop, Diane Russell, as they work together to capture an arsonist. Sipowicz becomes personally involved in a case after a woman he convinced to testify in a case is murdered. Martinez and Lt. Fancy square off at the annual department boxing tournament.

20.t: The Bookie and the Kooky Cookie
20.o: Help comes from an unexpected place as Sipowicz and Simone investigate the murder of a bookie. Joyce Novak, a witness to a murder, charges Simone with sexual harassment. Meanwhile, Sylvia and Sipowicz head to religious counseling to prepare for their upcoming nuptials.

21.o: An ill infant becomes the missing link in a serial rapist case Simone and Sipowicz are investigating. Simone suspects Russell of trying to cover up a serious problem; Medavoy considers getting back together with his wife with whom he is separated; and Irvin asks Simone for help when police officers assault him and his lover.

22.o: Sipowicz tries to get a confession and capitalizes on a mistaken identity. Lt. Fancy's brother is falsely accused of accepting bribes and Simone is able to uncover the truth behind the crime. Russell's apparent hangover almost results in a hazardous situation during a sweep. Later, the precinct throws a bachelor party for Sipowicz, who is noticeably dealing with pre-marriage jitters.

1.o: Martinez is shot when he and Medavoy walk in on a bar robbery. One of the robbers gets protection from the DA for information, which upsets James' colleagues. Sylvia breaks some news to Sipowicz, while Simone and Russell try for a reconcilliation.

2.o: An ill man is accused of killing his sister, but Simone suspects otherwise. Meanwhile, Medavoy and Sipowicz go under cover to recover a stolen Jewish icon. Sipowicz struggles to keep a secret.

3.o: Simone and Sipowicz get a break in a rape case when a man fitting the assailants description is seen in the station. Russell has to resolve her families domestic problems. Meanwhile, Martinez, on his first day back, gets some disappointing news from Lesniak.

4.o: A baby and a small child are shot and killed in a robbery. Sipowicz's bad mood hinders the investigation and causes a rift with Simone.

5.o: Ronnie Drucker, a detective under investigation, is reassigned to the 15th squad and compromises Simone. A young girl, confused by drugs, is the only witness to a shooting in a laundromat.

6.o: Simone and Sipowicz investigate the murder of an Indian woman, found strangled in her locked car. Medavoy and Martinez arrest a man acting strangely and find he's involved in a credit card scam. Lesniak and Russell team up to trap a gun dealer. Simone gets over-protective and makes Russell angry.

7.o: An ex-boxer, an old friend of Simone's, refuses to admit he's getting forgetful. The FBI take over a kidnap case, but Simone and Sipowicz find an informant and work the case on their own.

8.o: Simone's old pal Ray turns informant, from jail, in order to get a reduced sentence, but things don't go to plan. A father takes deadly revenge to protect his bullied son. Medavoy has to placate 2 actors who come to blows on stage.

9.o: A young girl is found stabbed, in Chinatown. Suspicion falls on the ex-boyfriend. Simone & Sipowicz Investigate. Martinez & Lezniak have to investigate a robbery, together, despite the bad feeling between them. Medavoy moves into the bunk-room.

10.o: A basketball game, held in the memory of a young boy, erupts into violence. 2 dead, 7 wounded. Andy has a race relation's problem with the organizer of the event that was witnessed by a reporter. Fancy and Sipowicz's relationship is on shaky ground as details of this event come to light and Andy is removed from the case.

11.o: A girl's body is found, burned, in an abandoned basement. Information from the husband of the girl's best friend points to a Russian, who had tried to date her, but had been refused. Simone puts together a scenario, involving the husband and 2 of his associates. Medavoy gets some overtime, on bodyguard duty and gets lucky in the card school.

12.o: A bruised and battered wife tells Sipowicz that her husband claimed to have killed somebody 8 years previously. Sipowicz follows a trail, leading back to 2 previous relationships. Russell is told that her father has been shot and killed. Her brother claims to have done it, but Simone thinks he's not telling the whole truth.

13.o: Russell gets a lawyer for her mother. Simone and Sipowicz investigate the shooting of a known mobster's son. Suspicion falls on his younger brother, but the father interferes with the search. 4.o: A bold choice from J.C. puts her in some dangerous crosshairs, and late-night drills on the road force the team to a breaking point.

5.o: Following her injury, Shannon begins to reconsider her position on keeping coach's misconduct a secret.

6.o: Shannon agrees to an on-camera interview, and Jordan's impromptu post on social media comes with consequences.

7.o: As J.C. tries to figure out who she can still trust, some damning personal drama catches up to one of the team members right before a big game.

8.o: Increasingly suspicious of the university administration, J.C. works to piece together the mystery of Hillman's sordid past.

9.o: As J.C. continues to dig into the university's cover ups, she must decide whether or not she'll ever come forward with the truth.

10.o: As J.C. reflects on quieter moments of her past, a pivotal figure finally comes forward with the truth as Hillman spirals towards his demise.

1.o: A new courthouse drama that follows the chaotic, hopeful and sometimes absurd lives of its judges, prosecutors and public defenders, as they work with bailiffs, clerks and cops to get justice for the people of Los Angeles amidst a flawed legal process.

2.t: A Long Day's Journey Into ICE
2.o: When an ICE agent pursues a defendant in Lola’s courtroom, she must fend him off while determining the appropriate sentence for the offender, an undocumented immigrant, whose crime was warning people of a grocery store selling spoiled goods.

3.o: Lola immerses herself in the world of online gaming when she presides over her first trial concerning cybercrimes, after two friends go head-to-head over a deleted avatar and all the assets associated with it. Also, Mark discovers life without Lola in the DA’s office is going to be lonelier than he thought, and Luke is set to be honored at the annual Valor Awards for his heroism.

4.o: When a jury's field trip to a crime scene takes a dramatic turn, Judge Lola Carmichael must determine if the trip she granted helped the defendant or biased the jury. Also, Mark is ready to take down a reputed crime boss, but discovers it's more complicated after he learns that a cop may have tampered with the evidence.

5.t: Devotees in the Courthouse of Love
5.o: Lola officiates her first nuptials on "Wedding Day," an annual event when couples can get married free of charge. A nun with a shady past is charged for a criminal act against the church that Lola believes is morally right.

6.o: Lola contends with a fame-hungry defendant, personal assistant Olivia McLeland, and a circus-like courtroom while presiding over a celebrity's murder trial that forces her to find peace at Sherri's home after she's chased by paparazzi.

7.o: Mark and Emily go head to head in court for the first time, and things get awkward when Mark must cross-examine Lola’s mother when she’s called as a character witness.

8.o: Lola and Emily find themselves on opposing sides when the key witness in a murder trial is the victim's 11-year-old daughter; when Mark's key witness winds up in jail, Luke accompanies Mark on a road trip to bring the witness back to testify.

9.t: How to Succeed in Law Without Really Re-Trying
9.o: When one of Lola's former murder cases is overturned on appeal, Mark helms the retrial and struggles to keep the bomber in jail, while Lola fears she may have prosecuted an innocent man.

10.o: Lola exercises a rarely used judicial power when she fires a lawyer for failing to provide a robust defense for his client. Also, Mark's dad, Vic, is arrested for murder.

11.o: Lola must defend herself before the Commission on Judicial Performance after a bias complaint is made against her; Judge Lisa Benner enlists Sara, Emily and Luke in staging a Wizard of Oz-themed mock trial.

12.t: What the Constitution Greens to Me
12.o: Following her battle with the Commission of Judicial Performance, Lola questions her own brand of creative justice; Benner assigns Lola a politically charged ecoterrorism trial that involves a senator's son.

13.o: Lola travels to Washington to help her husband land an important job at the FBI; Mark and Amy Quinn's relationship heats up as Amy tries to put together a winning defense for Vic Callan's murder case.

14.o: When Lola's mother makes a statement about her daughter in a newspaper, Lola must contend with her mother and her colleagues who commend her mother's harsh words about the justice system.

15.o: As Benner prepares to run for attorney general, she seeks Lola's help to search for anything that could compromise her campaign; Emily's client is hesitant to file a police report against her abusive boyfriend.

16.o: Lola’s world spins out of control when she presides over the trial of Emily’s client who rejects the rule of law and seizes control of the courtroom.

17.t: I Love You, You're Perfect, I Think
17.o: When Lola learns a secret about Judge Benner, she faces an excruciating dilemma; Emily avoids the implications of Luke's "I love you" as she represents a client with mental health issues.

18.o: Lola and Mark find themselves in trouble for pushing their bosses too hard in their pursuit of justice and fair play; as punishment, Lola is assigned to arraignment court for the week, while Mark is bumped down to the Charge Evaluation Unit.

19.o: Emily's composure nosedives when she defends a young man charged with felony domestic violence. Also, Lola struggles with supporting Robin's job offer and causes a rift with Mark when she reprimands his girlfriend, Amy, for grandstanding in the courtroom.

20.o: After a near breakdown, Emily arrives at a sobering conclusion, and Lola suggests she find professional help in order to get healthy. Also, Mark finds himself in an uncomfortable position after he agrees to do a police ride-along, and Lola is faced with her own crisis after learning that Robin didn't get the job in Los Angeles.

21.o: With Los Angeles under a mandatory shelter-in-place order and trials piling up, Judge Benner authorizes Judge Carmichael to preside over a virtual bench trial, a case regarding a dispute between brothers over a car. While Emily represents the defendant, Kurt Beto, Mark represents the prosecution, marking the first time he tries a case in Lola’s “court.”

1.o: Lola and Mark try to rebuild their friendship after Mark witnessed Lola being detained during a protest while defending a teen girl, amid an escalating encounter with police.

2.o: Lola may be asked to recuse herself from a case after the video of her detainment is leaked. Also, Mark continues to seek the hate crime enhancement in Jesse’s trial, even after being met with resistance, and the case is further complicated when Jesse is suspected of having a medical condition.

3.o: Presiding over Luke's cases forces Lola to acknowledge her own implicit biases and brings her into conflict with Judge Benner. On the home front, while Lola's husband, Robin, is in D.C., she ponders single motherhood and carries on a one-sided conversation with the new baby growing in her stomach. Also, Mark contemplates reopening an old investigation that causes friction between him and Amy

4.o: Shows up in her courtroom in his official FBI capacity, Benner insists that Lola recuse herself. Also, Mark Callan, in possession of a dossier of explosive evidence in an officer-involved shooting, enlists Sam to help him figure out what to do with it.

5.o: As the holidays approach, Lola begins her first jury trial during the pandemic; Mark digs deeper into his case against a police officer.

6.o: It's a new year and Lola's baby is due any day. She learns the jury was going to deliver a "not guilty" verdict in a case in which she pressured defendant Leon Parsons to take a plea deal, forcing her to decide whether to let the plea stand and protect her reputation, or reveal what she knows to Leon. Also, Mark's in the midst of an intense negotiation with DA Louis Bravo regarding how and when to arrest and charge Deputy Sheriff Rashel for attempted murder, when Mark is the victim of a brazen knife attack.

7.o: While Lola is on maternity leave after going into labor while on the bench, she attempts to participate remotely in Judge Brenner’s special training about brain science and the law. Also, when Luke finds himself opposite Emily on an armed robbery case, he sees an ally in his experiment with restorative justice, and Mark hits another roadblock in his high profile case against a sheriff’s deputy,

8.o: Mark is forced to prosecute his childhood icon, Samara Strong, an '80s Hollywood star accused of murdering her husband 30 years ago; Judge Laski is presiding over cases while Lola is on maternity leave.

9.o: Emily and Sam face off in the courtroom in an emotionally gripping case that will determine the fate of a mentally ill young man who attacked his father. Also, due to financial struggles, Rachel crashes at Mark and Amy’s place, reigniting Mark and Rachel’s flame.

10.o: Emily and Mark face off in court in a compelling jewellery store robbery case that puts the entire concept of eyewitnesses on trial; still struggling with financial woes, Amy brings in a potential client who happens to be a friend of Mark's father.

11.o: With Ness nearing the end of her clerkship, Lola sets her up to shadow Emily, who is defending a young man who reoffended, and the verdict lies with Judge Campbell who is notoriously harsh on repeat offenders. Also, Rachel reveals to Lola that she kissed Mark, and Mark struggles to find out why Luke’s name is on a list of cops dropped off by Deep Throat.

12.o: Mark and Sam think their "Romeo and Juliet"-style murder case of warring families is a slam dunk until their lead witness is proven to be lying under oath to protect the real eyewitness of a relative's murder. Also, Amy is furious with Mark after a secret is revealed and decides they need time apart.

13.o: Lola returns to the Hall of Justice and presides over a case where Amy represents a young woman accused of a swatting incident that resulted in the Dean of a university being shot. Also, Amy and Rachel make up, and Amy brings her divorce papers to her dying husband.

14.o: Lola is conflicted when a former judge, Judge Prudence Jenkins, whom she idolized, has been accused of bribery and is representing herself in a bench trial. Also, Mark moves forward with the case against McCarthy and he and Corrine Cuthbert each get one unchallenged request for a new judge, no questions asked.

15.o: Lola finds herself in the judicial hotseat when she presides over the case of former Sherriff Wayne McCarthy, and struggles because she and Mark can't talk to each other outside the courtroom. Also, Detective Rashel and other cops come forward to speak against McCarthy, but Corinne continues to turn their testimonies against them, and Luke demands that Mark allow him to take the stand.

16.o: Lola is tested like never before during a high-profile murder case when the women of Audubon and Associates—Rachel and Amy—combine forces with Public Defender Emily to represent the co-defendants. Also, David Sanders helps Lola court donations and endorsements to prepare for her upcoming re-election campaign.

17.o: The murder trials against Alexander Moore and Jack Allen begin, and the pressure mounts when Lola agrees to allow media into the courtroom to support her re-election campaign. Also, Mark and Amy commit to their relationship, even though they’re on opposite sides of the trial, and Luke looks for a way to win Emily back.

1.o: Los Angeles judges, prosecutors and public defenders work to get justice for the people amidst a flawed legal process.

2.o: Lola Stands to lose her judgeship due to Sherri's volunteer activities; Ness learns whether she passed the bar; a domestic violence case leaves Lola conflicted.

3.o: The investigation into Lola’s campaign takes a shocking turn; Amy makes a confession to Mark about their future; Emily’s new case tests her.

4.o: Lola courts Sherri to return to her chambers; Luke and Mark's friendship is tested while on opposite sides of a trial; Emily continues fighting for Charlotte.

5.t: It Ain't Over Till It's Over
5.o: Luke and Mark continue to fight on opposing sides of a murder case, and Mark has a startling revelation about the defendant. Lola runs into someone from her past, and Emily represents a juvenile charged with serious crimes.

6.o: In a race against the clock, Emily tries to find justice for a client she believes was wrongfully convicted of murder 20 years ago. Lola and Robin discuss hiring a nanny. Ness works on a new case.

7.o: Sara struggles with work, Luke represents a client accused of arson, and Andre makes an unexpected appearance in a case Lola is presiding over; Emily helps Gloria with a family issue.

8.o: Lola dreams of a world where she has made different life choices.

9.o: Mark goes up against the federal government on the smash and grab case.

10.o: Mark and Teddy take on Brandon Page in the smash and grab trial with Emily's client, Maddy, as their star witness. Meanwhile, André and Lola address their past, and Mark confronts Amy about her divorce.

11.o: Ness is in the ICU, Amy and Mark take a step forward, and Mark and Luke are on opposite sides of a high-profile case. Plus, Emily returns to the Public Defender's office, Robin and Lola's relationship is strained, and Sherri gets an unexpected visit.

12.o: An organ trafficking case takes a shocking turn, and a young girl is on trial for residential burglary. Plus, Amy and Mark start wedding planning, Lola and Robin remain strained, and Luke and Mark continue to pursue a serial killer theory.

13.o: Carl Brewer's murder trial begins, and it leads to a shocking discovery. Ness earns the respect of her firm during a huge civil class action lawsuit. Elsewhere, Emily introduces Luke to her father, and Robin confronts André.

14.o: Amy represents a sushi chef on trial for the attempted murder of his sous chef, and Emily represents a client charged with felony vandalism. Also, Lola learns about Robin’s conversation with André, and Emily and Luke’s relationship gets more complicated.

15.o: Emily represents a man who retaliated against his child's bully, and Amy tries her first case in the court of appeals. Meanwhile, Mark and Luke's road trip goes awry, and Luke and Emily's relationship hits a roadblock.

16.o: Mark's father Vic unexpectedly arrives with troubling news, Ness tries her first case, and the new Head Deputy DA is named. Also, Lola finally talks to André about their kiss.

17.o: Bravo's no-cash-bail policy is blamed for the murder of a famed philanthropist, and Bravo decides to try the case himself. Elsewhere, Amy and Ness represent a pro bono client accused of using false identification while seeking an abortion.

18.o: Emily represents someone charged with premeditated attempted murder for attacking her alleged rapist, and Mark is being strong armed by a mobster who is connected to his father.

19.o: The Russian mob asks Mark for another favor, except this time it involves Lola. Amy's estranged mother and sister crash her bachelorette party. Luke and Carver are on opposite sides of a three-strikes case and Gabriel has child custody issues.

20.t: Sometimes Truth Is Stranger Than Fiction
20.o: Emily represents a client charged with murder, and a new presiding judge is announced. Also, Mark's father makes a difficult decision to protect himself and his family. Later, Mark and Amy celebrate their wedding.

1.o: A young mercenary loner named Guts distinguishes himself in battle during a siege. As fate would have it, he also happens to catch the eye of Griffith, the charismatic young leader of the Band of the Hawk.

2.o: Griffith and the Band of the Hawk are rapidly gaining favor in the eyes of the king of Midland, but not everyone is pleased. During a battle, Guts and Griffith encounter an enemy like none they've ever faced.

3.o: Griffith has Guts carry out a high-risk mission for him, while he himself grows better acquainted with Princess Charlotte.

4.o: After being separated from the Band of the Hawk during a battle, Guts and Casca must fight for their lives against hostile Tudor forces.

5.o: Guts begins to question his place in the Band of the Hawk, while Griffith puts the band in play for his riskiest gambit yet.

6.o: It's do-or-die time as the Band of the Hawk goes up against Tudor's mightiest knights in an attempt to recapture the fortress of Doldrey and bring the war to an end.

7.o: The Hawks have their moment of glory as heroes of the kingdom, but Guts decides the time has finally come for him to pursue his own dreams alone.

8.o: Guts sets off on his own in a dramatic fashion, and this seemingly small event triggers what becomes a downward spiral for Griffith and the Hawks.

9.o: After a year has passed, Guts returns to find the Band of the Hawk reduced to a persecuted group of fugitives, with Casca as their acting leader.

10.o: When the Band of the Hawk infiltrates Windham to rescue Griffith from prison, what they discover upends all their plans and expectations.

11.o: As Griffith vacillates between desperate hope and hopeless despair, the Band of the Hawk is drawn into an event far beyond their comprehension.

12.o: Griffith makes one last fateful decision, as the rest of the Hawks struggle for survival against virtually insurmountable odds.

1.o: Won Mi-ho is the only heiress to the Daehan Group. She falls for her aunt’s plot and becomes the center of a controversy after beating up a person in the middle of the city. Mi-ho is sent to Jeju Island until things quiet down, but she comes across a lust demon in a wedding dress.

2.o: Not only was Mi-ho chased twice by lust demons, but the police are now also treating her like a drug user. She is trying to come up with a plan to escape Jeju Island and go back to Seoul. But before she could get on a plane, she ended up in a life-threatening car chase with a lust demon.

3.o: Johan moves into Mi-ho’s villa to live with Van and Mi-ho, disguised as Butler Jang’s nephew. Mi-ho is displeased with Van, who doesn’t seem to cooperate and can’t even drive a car. On top of that, Johan starts tagging along to school.

4.o: Mi-ho meets the last of Benjulle’s trees after a fierce battle in Benjulle’s forest. Mi-ho returns to her villa after saving Su-ryeon and starts planning on how to punish Gyeong-jun. Meanwhile, Johan provokes Van to find out his identity, summoning the hidden nature of the lust demon. Mi-ho comes to look for Van and Johan and sees Van transforming into a lust demon.

5.o: Van feels guilty for nearly killing Mi-ho and disappears into the darkness. To find Van, Mi-ho goes through rough mountain tracks to Taejangsa Temple, only to walk away after being hurt by his coldness. Meanwhile, the number of mysterious murder cases where the organs were extracted from the victims is increasing all over Jeju Island.

6.o: Johan brings Chan-hee to the villa. They spend time happily together, promising each other that they would not part again. However, Chan-hee has already turned into a lust demon, and he leaves Johan’s room to go after Mi-ho’s life. After finding out about the secret of reincarnation, Mi-ho visits and asks Geum Baek-ju to help her become Wonjeong.

7.o: Long ago, Jeju was thrown into confusion by an outbreak of lust demons. Wonjeong, fated to save the island by establishing the Barrier, secretly visits and forms a friendship with two boys, Van and Gungtan, who were raised solely to kill lust demons. Ten years later, Wonjeong returns to Taejangsa Temple after completing her training to establish the Barrier.

8.o: Johan overcomes his despair after Chan-hee's death. Mi-ho, who is in pain and blaming herself, vows not to lose anyone else who is precious. From then, she begins receiving intense training from Geum Baek-ju at Granny Haenyeo's Home to regain the power of Wonjeong. Johan and Van follow Mi-ho but observe from a distance so that they don't interrupt her energy.

9.o: Gungtan remembers once again that Wonjeong had sealed him in the past and escapes without being able to harm Mi-ho. Captivated by fear and anger, Gungtan begins to plunge the world into darkness. Mi-ho starts to blame herself, believing that the tragedy will only end when she dies.

10.o: Mi-ho finds out about Butler Chang's secret and tries to kill herself as she feels betrayed. The moment Van rushes to Mi-ho and holds her hand, she recovers all the memories from the past. Gungtan rages as he feels dejected after watching Mi-ho fail to regain power even after her memory has returned.

11.o: Van learns that Mi-ho will vanish if she regains the power, leaving only Wonjeong. After agonizing, Van tries to stop Mi-ho’s training to become Wonjeong. Mi-ho is just frustrated and upset at Van’s sudden behavior.

12.o: It's finally the day to establish the Barrier. Mi-ho, on her way to the altar, fights a great battle against lust demons alongside Butler Chang, who has returned, and Johan, who woke up from a coma. After defeating countless lust demons, Mi-ho leaves the rest to Van, Johan, and Butler Chang and goes up to the altar.

2.o: A desperate Mbande asks for help from Njinga, who attempts to make peace with the Portuguese. After an unexpected death, Njinga takes on a pivotal role.

3.o: Now on the throne, Njinga must grow her army and solidify her power. In need of resources, she makes sacrifices and strikes a deal with a former enemy.

4.o: Tensions run high as Njinga negotiates with a European power to save her own as she moves to establish an independent kingdom and be recognized as queen.

2.o: تندلع سلسلة من الأحداث العنيفة بعد نشر السُّلطات صور الشقيقين أمام عامة الشعب. وفي تلك الأثناء، تظهر أدلة من ماضيهما تزيل الستار عن قصة معقدة.

7.o: As Wen-fang's team races to trace down a suspicious viral post, a reckless Ya-ching scrambles to cover up a damaging secret.

8.o: Engulfed in a scandal, Chao Chang-tse works frantically to contain the fallout. Ya-ching, summoning up her courage, decides to take a bold step.

1.o: حين تنجرف مئات الكيلوغرامات من الكوكايين إلى الساحل بالقرب من قريتهم الصغيرة، تهبّ بكل تأكيد رياح التغيير على حياة "إدواردو" و"سيلفيا" و"رافايل" و"كارلينيوس".

2.o: يبدأ "إدواردو" وأصدقاؤه بتجارة كوكايين القارب الغارق، لكن وصول المحققة "فرياش" إلى القرية يعقّد مشروعهم.

3.o: تُقلق هزة أرضية صفو الحياة في الجزيرة، لكن زعيم عصابة المخدرات "مونتي" يقلب الأمور رأسًا على عقب حينما يحاول استرداد الكوكايين الذي فقده.

4.o: يشهد المشروع انطلاقة جيدة أخيرًا، وتهرع "فرياش" و"مونتي" باستماتة للعثور على المخدرات، لكن ثمة حادثة تتسبب في دخول منافس آخر إلى سياق الأحداث.

5.t: No One Escapes from an Island
5.o: يختفي "إدواردو" و"رافايل"، وتنتقل "سيلفيا" على مضض للعيش مع والدها، الذي يطلب منه "إيان" و"برونا" مساعدتهما عندما يتلقيان تهديدًا خطيرًا.

6.o: يلجأ الأصدقاء إلى مخبأ "جو" كملاذ لهم في الوقت الذي يحاولون فيه التعافي من خسارة فادحة، لكنهم لن يستطيعوا الهرب طويلًا من نكباتهم.

7.o: عندما يرسم "جو" الخطة النهائية لبيع المخدرات والهرب إلى "الولايات المتحدة"، تحدث الفُرقة بين الأصدقاء، ويصبح طموح "إدواردو" موضع شكّ.

1.o: لا تسير خطة "إدواردو" للهرب كما هو متوقع. وبينما تُخفي "سيلفيا" سرًّا، وتنتقل إمبراطورية المخدرات من يد إلى أخرى، يظل تركيز المحققة "فرياش" مُنصبًّا على "جزر الأزور".

2.o: تستعين "سيلفيا" بـ"إدواردو" وبقية المجموعة لتنفيذ عملية جديدة. وبينما ترتبك أجواء الجزيرة بعودة مفاجئة لشخص ما، يكابد "كارلينيوس" آلامه.

3.o: بينما يحاول المحققون كشف جرائم الإيطاليين، تصل تاجرة مخدرات برازيلية إلى "جزر الأزور"، حيث توجّه إنذارًا نهائيًا يتسبب في انحراف خطط "إدواردو" عن مسارها.

4.o: يكتشف "أورلاندو" أمرًا يُجبر "سيلفيا" على تحديد ولاءها. وبينما يبحث الأصدقاء عن مشترٍ لصفقة "أوفيليا"، يعمد "إدواردو" إلى تنفيذ خطته الخاصة.

5.t: Throw a Rock, Hide Your Hand
5.o: تشهد الأجواء خيانة تُفضي إلى عواقب وخيمة، بينما تقنع "سيلفيا" المجموعة بالمساعدة في التعامل مع شحنة كبيرة، وتكتشف المفتشة "فرياش" وجود جاسوس مندسّ بين صفوف الشرطة.

6.o: يواجه الأصدقاء عدّة عراقيل خلال تنفيذ العملية، بينما يحسم "إدواردو" و"سيلفيا" وضع علاقاتهما العاطفية وسط ظهور أعداء جدد وحدوث مأساة أخرى.

1.o: Iroha Inukai lives in Animal Town with her beloved pet dog, Komugi. At Kaihin Park, she is attacked by a strange creature, a Garugaru. At that moment, a stone Komugi found begins to sparkle…

2.t: Let's All Be Friends! Cure Friendy!
2.o: Mey Mey has returned to his original form after having been a Garugaru and asks Komugi to help his friends too. Komugi says she won’t do it unless Iroha joins her, but then a new Garugaru appears.

3.o: In Niko Garden, Mey Mey once again asks Iroha and Komugi, “Please help my friends.” Meanwhile, on his way home from Iroha's house, Satoru comes across a mysterious black egg.

4.o: Iroha and Komugi return to the Niko Garden and see how the power of a Kirarin Animal can restore it. Once back, they hurry to be the first customers on the opening day of the new Pretty Holic store.

5.o: Komugi meets a girl named Ema and her Pomeranian puppy and is reminded of her puppy days. As she is feeling gratitude to Iroha for caring for her, a new Garugaru appears.

6.o: Iroha and Komugi get into an argument after they realize the leash they always use for their walks is gone. A new Garugaru appears, but Wonderful gets frozen with fear.

7.o: Komugi runs away from Iroha’s home. She meets Satoru in town, who takes her to his house. Meanwhile, Iroha hears about Mayu’s relationship with Yuki and receives a new harness.

8.o: It’s Mayu’s first day at her new school, and she’s in Iroha’s class. Meanwhile, Komugi tries to go meet Iroha at school, but she gets distracted and winds up at Pretty Holic.

9.o: Thanks to a Niko Diamond miracle, Komugi is now able to go to school with Iroha. She immediately becomes popular, but after eating lunch she gets sleepy and turns back into a dog.

10.o: Mayu has come up with ideas for new products at Pretty Holic, but can’t decide which one to use. Watching Komugi and Iroha she remembers when she first met Yuki.

11.t: A Giant Creature Hiding in the Mountains?!
11.o: Komugi and the gang hear a rumor about a mysterious creature appearing at Mount Miharashi and decide to investigate. They climb to the summit but don’t see any signs of a Garugaru, but that’s where they notice something important.

12.o: Mayu tells Iroha she’s concerned because Yuki seems to be disappearing a lot recently. Iroha brings a security camera to Mayu’s room and as they wait for something to happen, Komugi senses a Garugaru and jumps up.

13.o: Komugi and the gang set out to find Nyammy and discover her intentions when the scent of the compact Mayu designed leads them to Pretty Holic.

14.o: Yuki isn’t feeling well, so Mayu brings her to Iroha’s house. Iroha suggests that she spend the night to keep watch over Yuki, but the next morning Komugi senses the presence of a Garugaru.

15.t: A Day in the Life of Mey Mey the Butler-Sheep!
15.o: Komugi and the others spend a day helping Mey Mey take care of the Kirarin Animals in Niko Garden. But the Kirarin Animals seem to be hiding something.

16.t: The Mystery of the Mirror Stone
16.o: Komugi and the others think they might have found a clue to the mystery of the town’s Mirror Stone. Meanwhile, Iroha’s parents see Komugi talking while she’s in dog form.

17.o: The season of animal babies has come to Animal Town. Komugi and the others go on a “Baby Animal Tour” but while they are at it, a Garugaru appears.

18.o: Yuki, the true identity of Nyammy, tells Mayu not to associate with Komugi and Iroha. Mayu goes to school that day feeling conflicted, but on the way home a Garugaru appears.

19.o: Mayu worries about Yuki, who has left home and not come back. Near Pretty Holic, Yuki is watching over Mayu from afar when the same Garugaru as last time appears before her once again.

20.o: Although she agreed to come to Niko Garden, Yuki refuses to help Komugi and the others. She refuses to change her mind even when Mayu asks, but then a new Garugaru appears...

21.o: Just like Komugi, Yuki has also started going to school with everyone. Yuki is good at studying and sports. After observing Iroha, she decides to tell her about a former friend of Mayu’s.

22.o: Komugi and Iroha are invited by their dog trainer friend Inuzuka to try a dog sport called Agility. At first, Komugi doesn’t understand the obstacle course and just runs through everything.

23.o: During an afternoon nap, Komugi dreams about a lonely wolf howling. After that, she goes out to the Star Festival and learns that Japanese wolves once lived near Animal Town.

24.o: All of the Kirarin Animals have returned, and Niko Garden is restored. The maker of the garden, Niko-sama, appears in egg form, and for some reason the egg comes to Iroha’s room.

25.o: For their summer independent research project, Komugi and the others go to the beach in Animal Town. They decide to play in the ocean until the sea turtles begin to lay their eggs, when a Garugaru appears.

26.o: Komugi and the others go outside for a walk and shopping despite the extreme heat and nearly collapse before finally taking shelter at Satoru’s house. But not long after they decide to go back outside, a Garugaru appears.

27.t: We Want to Find a Tsuchinoko!
27.o: The mayor of Animal Town is hosting a Tsuchinoko Tracking Competition and Komugi and the others are joining in. While failing to find any clues, Mey Mey comes to check on the Niko-sama egg and drops it down a slope.

28.t: Let's Play at the Ohkuma Farm♪
28.o: Komugi and the others visit their classmate Ohkuma, whose family runs a farm. They try milking cows, and they watch a sheepdog show, but then a Garugaru appears.

29.o: The egg finally cracks, and Niko returns. Komugi and the others return to Niko Garden together with Niko and learn about Gaou, the one who turned the animals into Garugarus.

30.o: Niko explains the secret of the Mirror Stone to Mey Mey. Meanwhile, Komugi and Yuki are trying to help Iroha and Mayu recover from the shock of the wolves’ anger.

31.o: Mayu begins uploading photos and videos of Yuki to Curesta. When her posts get popular, a friend, Yuma, who she knew from before she changed schools sees her post and comes to Pretty Holic.

32.o:
Komugi and the others go to the Animal Town zoo, Petting Zoo. They get to see animals up close and meet an elephant Iroha has known since she was little.

Note: This episode marks the 1,000th episode of the Pretty Cure franchise.

33.o: At Iroha’s house, her father Tsuyoshi has a lot of animals visiting him to get trimmed. Yuki and Mayu, then Satoru come to the house, and hear the story of how Tsuyoshi became a trimmer from Iroha’s mother, Yoko.

34.o: Mayu's father returns to hold a photo exhibition in Animal Town after a long time away. Yuki chooses not to go to the exhibit to spend some time alone and encounters a lost kitten in a park.

35.o: Yuki and Mayu see Satoru receiving a confession of love from a female classmate. That day after school, Satoru hears from Iroha that “Keiji, who I adore, is coming to my place” and gets quite a shock.

36.o: Satoru works up his courage and confesses his feelings to Iroha. But Iroha is so surprised she runs away. Iroha thinks hard about Satoru’s “special feelings” up until the morning comes….

37.o: Iroha and Satoru arrange to meet in front of the Mirror Stone and go on their first date. Komugi plans to spend the day with Yuki and Mayu, but Mey Mey has a hard time letting Iroha have Satoru to herself and tries to follow them.

38.o: Komugi is playing in the dog run when a volunteer sees her and calls her “Marron.” Iroha decides to meet with Komugi’s previous family that she lived with until two years ago.

39.o: It’s Halloween in Animal Town, and as people and animals roam the streets in costume, Komugi, who is dressed as a wolf, finds another wolf and chases after him. It’s a quiet, gentle wolf who is loved by animals, but…

40.o: Komugi and the others go to Toboe Shrine, where Gaou might be. However, Niko-sama’s power goes out of control after trying to track him, turning Iroha into a dog and Mayu into a cat.

41.o: The Drama Club invites Yuki to join them in a performance for the drama festival. As always, Yuki isn’t interested, but she finally agrees as long as she is able to wear a costume made by Mayu.

42.o: The mayor asks Mayu’s father, Takayuki, to take the pictures for the Animal Calendar, so Komugi and the others show him around town. Their first stop is the off-leash area at Kaihin Park.

43.o: Mayu decides to hold a knitting class for her classmates. Zakuro happens to see this and is inspired to knit something for Gaou.

44.o: One morning, Iroha runs into Otsuru and her dog Fuku and decides to hold a celebration for Fuku’s 18th birthday. While preparing, she finds a photo of Otsuru with a different dog.

45.o: All of the Niko Animals have returned to Niko Garden, but Iroha is feeling down because of Fuku. Komugi and the others are concerned, but then hear Torame’s howling echo through town.

46.o: Komugi and the others are invited to the Niko Garden Christmas party. Partway through, Yuki leaves to go to a different party and Komugi comes along, and on their way back they run into Zakuro.

47.o: Yuki and Mayu experience their first New Year in Animal Town and go with Komugi and the gang to see the first sunrise and make their first shrine visit of the new year. The town is full of New Year spirit, until a wolf’s howl echoes through the air.

48.o: The Precures face off with many wolf Gaogaons summoned by Gaou. Niko tries to restrain Gaou, but he catches her off-guard and steals the power of the Niko Diamond.

49.o: Subaru tries to revive Gaou using the combined powers of the Diamond Unicorn and the Mirror Stone. But when he realizes it’s not possible, he puts the Niko Diamond into his body and transforms into a giant wolf.

50.o: Reunited with Gaou, Subaru joins his friends and disappears into the light. The Pretty Cures see them off and then it’s time to say goodbye to Niko and Mey Mey before they return to Niko Garden.

1.o: The life of Razan and her family of four is disrupted when two guests arrive for a visit that lasts for days and ends in a tragic accident.

2.o: Razan and her two children move to a secluded village to stay in a mysterious house with the elderly Abu Ghanem, but soon realize that evil lurks within.

3.o: Crime escalates in the village. Razan sets boundaries for Amer, who tries to push Noura away.

4.o: A new detective is tasked with solving the crimes. An intruder breaks into Razan's bedroom. Abu Jihad gives Noura an earful.

5.o: Adel begins his intensive investigations at the Cursed House. Razan uncovers a dark side of Amer’s life when he opens up to her about his past. Noura makes a desperate request of Amer.

6.o: Upon arriving at Waheed’s house, Amer makes a shocking discovery. A horrific crime rocks the Cursed House, forcing Razan into silence to keep Nader’s safe.

7.o: Adel adopts a new approach in his investigations. Noura puts an end to Waheed's constant insults. Abu Jihad behaves strangely.

8.o: Zaid eavesdrops on Razan and Amer’s conversation. Later, he loses it when Noura drops a bombshell before him. Abu Jihad orders his son to cut any ties with Nader and Nadera.

9.o: Zaid and Lamia devise the perfect plot against Razan. Bashar feels wronged after Waheed shares the latest developments in his relationship with Noura.

10.o: Nader and Nadera's decision sets them at odds with each other. Umm Jihad returns the entrusted item to Razan. Adel sets a trap for the murderer.

1.o: Kai's destiny changes when he reproduces an ability that he saw in a strange dream.

2.o: Kai travels to Eda Village with Lady Jose, who teaches him about the duty of guardian bearers.

3.o: Kai returns to the valley where his journey started, where he learns more about the valley god.

4.o: Kai's accomplishments attract the attention of Vezin, and Kai recalls a childhood memory.

5.o: An inspector from the central plain visits Rag Village, and Kai escorts a priest following an org band.

6.o: Kai battles Adurakan, a powerful org guardian bearer, in order to protect the valley.

7.o: The scouting party returns to Rag Village only to learn it was devastated by an attack during their absence.

8.o: Kai and Nada fight for their lives while Lag Village defends itself from another macaque attack.

9.o: Macaques come flooding through the gate opened by the inspector. Will Kai arrive in time to save Lag Village?

10.o: The macaques ask Kai to save them from the evil Great God Kanae.

11.o: Kai and his allies confront the diabo, but it is not easily defeated.

12.o: Kai's life is slowly drained away after being swallowed by the diabo when he hears a voice...

1.o: England, 1705: Nell Jackson's supernatural fighting skills stir up trouble on her return from war.

2.o: On the run from the law, Nell, Roxy and George turn to highway robbery to survive.

3.t: A Private Joke with the Queen
3.o: Poynton's dark magic catches up with Nell. One of her sisters is dangerously wounded in the escape.

4.o: Nell risks capture to find a doctor, and the gang receive help from some unlikely sources.

5.o: Nell goes to Newgate Prison to try and rescue Devereux, and Roxy and George meet their Uncle Jack.

6.o: Nell sets out to rescue George, and Rasselas finally confronts Sofia.

7.o: The gang head to Fleet Street to stop the news sheets from printing lies about Nell.

8.o: Nell and the gang race against time to stop Poynton and save the Queen.
